transcript.en: Hi everyone, welcome to the Snow Centre.
transcript.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到Snow Centre。

transcript.en: My name's Annie.
transcript.zh: 我叫安妮。

transcript.en: I hope you enjoyed the bus trip from the airport -
transcript.zh: 我希望大家会喜欢从机场出发的巴士之旅 -

transcript.en: we've certainly got plenty of snow today!
transcript.zh: 有很漂亮的雪景等着大家。

transcript.en: Well, you've come to New Zealand's premier snow and ski centre,
transcript.zh: 欢迎大家来到新西兰首屈一指的滑雪中心，

transcript.en: and we've a whole load of activities for you during your week here.
transcript.zh: 我们为大家准备了为期一周的丰富活动。

transcript.en: Most visitors come here for the cross-country skiing,
transcript.zh: 大多数游客都来这里越野滑雪，

transcript.en: where you're on fairly flat ground for most of the time rather than going down steep mountainsides.
transcript.zh: 这里大部分路段都是平坦的雪场，而不是陡峭的山坡。

transcript.en: There are marked trails, but you can also leave these and go off on your own and that's an experience not to be missed.
transcript.zh: 有做了标记的雪径，但是你也可以另辟蹊径，也是不错的体验。

transcript.en: You can go at your own speed – it's great aerobic exercise if you really push yourself,
transcript.zh: 你可以按照自己喜欢的速度滑行 - 速度快的话，这是一项不错的有氧运动，

transcript.en: or if you prefer you can just glide gently along and enjoy the beautiful scenery.
transcript.zh: 你也可以慢慢滑，享受四周美丽的景色。

transcript.en: This afternoon, you'll be going on a dog-sled trip.
transcript.zh: 今天下午会有一次狗拉雪橇之旅。

transcript.en: You may have seen our dogs on TV recently racing in the winter sled festival.
transcript.zh: 最近电视上就播放了一次我们的冬季狗拉雪橇比赛。

transcript.en: If you want, you can have your own team for the afternoon and learn how to drive them, following behind our leader on the trail.
transcript.zh: 如果大家愿意，下午可以自己组队，在教练的指导下学习如何拉雪橇。

transcript.en: Or if you'd prefer, you can just sit back in the sled and enjoy the ride as a passenger.
transcript.zh: 或者就坐在雪橇上，享受乘客的旅程。

transcript.en: At the weekend, we have the team relay event, and you're all welcome to join in.
transcript.zh: 周末，我们举办了团队接力活动，欢迎大家加入。

transcript.en: We have a local school coming along, and a lot of the teachers are taking part too.
transcript.zh: 我们有一所当地学校，还有很多老师也参加了。

transcript.en: Participation rather than winning is the main focus, and there's a medal for everyone who takes part.
transcript.zh: 胜负不是关键，重在参与，每个参与者都能获得一枚奖章。

transcript.en: Participants are in teams of two to four, and each team must complete four laps of the course.
transcript.zh: 参赛者两到四人组成一队，每队必须完成四圈的任务。

transcript.en: For your final expedition, you'll head off to Mount Frenner wearing a pair of special snow shoes which allow you to walk on top of the snow.
transcript.zh: 旅程的终点是Frenner山，穿上一双特殊的雪鞋，在雪地上行走。

transcript.en: This is an area where miners once searched for gold, though there are very few traces of their work left now.
transcript.zh: 这是矿工们曾经淘金的地方，尽管现在已经丝毫看不到以前的痕迹了。

transcript.en: When the snow melts in summer, the mountain slopes are carpeted in flowers and plants.
transcript.zh: 当夏天积雪融化时，山坡上铺满了花草。

transcript.en: It's a long ascent though not too steep, and walkers generally take a couple of days to get to the summit and return.
transcript.zh: 这是一次漫长的攀登，虽然不是太陡峭，但是步行者通常需要几天时间才能登顶并返回。

transcript.en: You'll spend the night in our hut half-way up the mountain.
transcript.zh: 在半山腰上的小屋里过夜。

transcript.en: That's included in your package for the stay.
transcript.zh: 这包括在旅行套餐里面了。

transcript.en: It's got cooking facilities, firewood and water for drinking.
transcript.zh: 屋里面有烹饪设施、柴火和饮用水，

transcript.en: For washing, we recommend you use melted snow, though, to conserve supplies.
transcript.zh: 我们建议大家用融雪洗涤，以便节省存的水

transcript.en: We can take your luggage up on our snowmobile for you for just ten dollars a person.
transcript.zh: 行李可以放在雪地车上，每人只需十美元。

transcript.en: The hut has cooking facilities so you can make a hot meal in the evening and morning, but you need to take your own food.
transcript.zh: 小屋有烹饪设施，所以可以在晚上和早上做顿热饭菜，但是要自己带食材。

transcript.en: The weather on Mount Frenner can be very stormy.
transcript.zh: 弗伦纳山上的天气可能有很大的暴风雨。

transcript.en: In that case, stay in the hut - generally the storms don't last long.
transcript.zh: 在这种情况下，留在小屋 - 通常暴风雨不会持续很长时间。

transcript.en: Don't stress about getting back here to the centre in time to catch the airport bus – they'll probably not be running anyway.
transcript.zh: 不要着急回到中心赶机场巴士 - 反正车也不能开。

transcript.en: We do have an emergency locator beacon in the hut but only use that if it's a real emergency, like if someone's ill or injured.
transcript.zh: 我小屋里面有一个应急定位信标，但只有在真正的紧急情况下才能使用，比如有人生病或受伤时，

transcript.en: Now, let me tell you something about the different ski trails you can follow during your stay here.
transcript.zh: 现在，让我告诉你一些不同的滑雪路线。

transcript.en: Highland Trail's directly accessible from where we are now.
transcript.zh: Highland Trail可以从我们所在的位置进入。

transcript.en: This trail's been designed to give first-timers an experience they'll enjoy regardless of their age or skill
transcript.zh: 这条雪径旨在为初学者提供无论年龄或技能如何都能享受的体验

transcript.en: but it's also ideal for experts to practise their technique.
transcript.zh: 但它也是专家练习技术的理想选择。

transcript.en: Then there's Pine Trail …if you're nervous about skiing, leave this one to the experts.
transcript.zh: 然后是Pine Trail ……如果你对滑雪感到紧张，请不要轻易进入这条适合专家的雪径。

transcript.en: You follow a steep valley looking right down on the river below - scary!
transcript.zh: 沿着一条陡峭的山谷望着下面的河 - 吓人！

transcript.en: But if you've fully mastered the techniques needed for hills, it's great fun.
transcript.zh: 但是，如果你已经完全掌握了爬山所需的技术，那非常有趣。

transcript.en: Stony Trail's a good choice once you've got a general idea of the basics.
transcript.zh: 一旦你对基础知识有了总体的了解，Stony Trail是一个不错的选择。

transcript.en: There are one or two tricky sections, but nothing too challenging.
transcript.zh: 有一两个棘手的部分，但没有太大的挑战性。

transcript.en: There's a shelter half-way where you can sit and take a break and enjoy the afternoon sunshine.
transcript.zh: 半路有一个庇护所，可以坐下休息，享受午后的阳光。

transcript.en: And finally, Loser's Trail.
transcript.zh: 最后，Loser's Trail。

transcript.en: This starts off following a gentle river valley
transcript.zh: 从温和的河谷开始，

transcript.en: but the last part is quite exposed so the snow conditions can be challenging. .
transcript.zh: 最后一段经常会有下雪天气，因此挑战性巨大

transcript.en: if it's snowing or windy, check with us before you set out to make sure the trail's open that day.
transcript.zh: 如果是下雪或多风天气，出发前要提前跟我们确认一下道路是否开通

transcript.en: Right, so now if you'd like to follow me, we'll get started …
transcript.zh: 所以，如果大家现在想跟我来，我们就开始……
